meta.project: Comprehensive Accounting and Branch Management System

product_overview: A full-featured accounting and branch management system designed for businesses to efficiently manage their financials, branches, banking, and related operations through an intuitive web interface supporting Arabic RTL.
core_goals: Provide a unified dashboard for quick access to key metrics and modules across branches and accounting.
Enable comprehensive branch management with detailed location hierarchy and status control.
Offer robust accounting functionalities including chart of accounts, journal entries, financial reports, and cost centers.
Support bank and cash management processes including reconciliation, transfers, and cheque management.
Facilitate product costing and fixed asset management with multiple depreciation methods.
Allow data export and bulk operations to streamline workflows.
Ensure secure user authentication and RTL interface for Arabic users.
key_features: Unified Dashboard with branch overview and navigation in Arabic RTL interface.
Branch Management supporting CRUD operations, location hierarchy, and active status toggling.
Accounting Dashboard displaying financial overview and quick access to accounts and reports.
Hierarchical Chart of Accounts management with multiple account types.
Journal Entry management including draft, posting, reversing, and bulk operations.
Comprehensive Financial Reports: Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow, Trial Balance, General Ledger.
Cost Center management with budget tracking and expense allocation.
Bank Management with reconciliation, import, and transaction matching capabilities.
Cash Management with receipts, payments, and internal transfers.
Cheque Portfolio management with full CRUD operations.
Loan Management dashboard with creation and payment tracking.
Revenue and Expense Entry management with supplier and owner filters.
Electronic Payment Accounts handling (Fawry, Visa).
Treasury Management for cash location CRUD.
Account Transfers with approval workflows.
Product Costing system including cost analysis and history tracking.
Advanced features including bank reconciliation, recurring entries, budgets, assets, depreciation methods, and audit logs.
Fixed Assets Management with multiple depreciation methods.
Export Tools supporting CSV, Excel, PDF export for multiple entities.
Quick Operations dashboard for bulk updates, email, delete, and exports.
Financial Analysis including ratio reports and budget variance comparisons.
Secure Authentication and login with redirect to main dashboard.
user_flow_summary: User logs in and lands on Unified Dashboard showing key branch and financial metrics in Arabic RTL.
User navigates to Branch Management to create, edit, or view branches, showrooms, warehouses, and outlets.
User accesses Accounting Dashboard to view financial summaries and quickly reach accounts, journal entries, or reports.
User creates or edits Chart of Accounts through hierarchical views and manages account types.
User manages Journal Entries including saving drafts, posting, reversing, and performing bulk actions.
User generates and views standard financial reports such as balance sheet and income statement.
User manages cost centers including setting budgets, allocating expenses, and reviewing reports.
User handles bank accounts, reconciliations, and imports statements to match transactions.
User oversees cash management activities including receipts, payments, and internal transfers.
User manages cheque portfolios fully including creation, viewing, and deletion.
User tracks bank loans with details and payment schedules.
User creates revenue and expense entries and runs supplier or owner-based reports.
User manages electronic payment accounts for various payment terminals.
User maintains treasury cash storage locations.
User performs account transfers with proper approval workflows.
User uses product costing features to analyze and update costs and view cost history.
User utilizes advanced accounting features such as recurring entries, audit logs, and fixed assets depreciation handling.
User exports data in CSV, Excel, or PDF from various modules.
User applies bulk operations through Quick Operations dashboard for efficiency.
User conducts financial analysis with ratio calculations and budget comparisons.
validation_criteria: Unified Dashboard properly loads and displays accurate branch and financial metrics in RTL layout.
Branch CRUD operations correctly reflect in the system with proper hierarchy and status handling.
Accounting features perform all create, read, update, and delete operations as intended with accurate data.
Journal entries can be created, posted, reversed, and bulk processed without errors.
Financial reports generate correctly with accurate and up-to-date financial data.
Bank and cash management workflows process transactions and reconciliations accurately.
Product costing calculations and history tracking are correct and update promptly.
Fixed asset and depreciation calculations follow prescribed methods and reflect accurately.
Data export functionality produces correct files in requested formats with complete data sets.
Quick operations effectively perform bulk updates, emails, deletions, and exports as expected.
Authentication system enforces secure login and redirects correctly to the dashboard.
User interface is fully adapted to Arabic RTL with all navigation and data displayed correctly.

features.name: Unified Dashboard
features.description: Main dashboard showing branches/showrooms overview with key metrics, navigation to all modules. Arabic RTL interface.

features.name: Branch Management
features.description: CRUD operations for managing branches, showrooms, warehouses, and outlets. Supports location hierarchy, toggling active status, and setting current working location.

features.name: Accounting Dashboard
features.description: Main accounting dashboard with financial overview, quick access to accounts, journal entries, and reports.

features.name: Chart of Accounts
features.description: Hierarchical chart of accounts management with create, edit, and detail views. Supports account types: assets, liabilities, equity, revenue, expenses.

features.name: Journal Entries
features.description: Create, view, and manage journal entries with draft/posted status. Supports posting, reversing, and bulk operations.

features.name: Financial Reports
features.description: Comprehensive financial reports including Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, Trial Balance, and General Ledger.

features.name: Cost Centers
features.description: Cost center management with budget tracking, expense allocation, and reporting.

features.name: Bank Management
features.description: Bank accounts management, bank reconciliation, statement import, and transaction matching.

features.name: Cash Management
features.description: Cash positions overview, cash receipts, payments, and internal transfers between treasuries and banks.

features.name: Cheque Management
features.description: Cheque portfolio management with create, view, detail and delete operations.

features.name: Loan Management
features.description: Bank loans dashboard with loan creation, details, and payment tracking.

features.name: Revenue & Expense Entries
features.description: Revenue and expense entry management with supplier revenue reports and owner-based filtering.

features.name: Electronic Accounts
features.description: Management of electronic payment accounts (Fawry machines, Visa machines).

features.name: Treasury Management
features.description: Treasury CRUD operations for managing cash storage locations.

features.name: Account Transfers
features.description: Transfers between accounts (bank-to-bank, treasury-to-bank, etc.) with approval workflow.

features.name: Product Costing
features.description: Product costing system with cost components, analysis, bulk updates, and cost history tracking.

features.name: Advanced Features
features.description: Advanced accounting features index including bank reconciliation, recurring entries, budgets, assets/depreciation, financial statements, and audit log.

features.name: Fixed Assets & Depreciation
features.description: Fixed asset management with multiple depreciation methods (straight-line, declining balance, sum of years).

features.name: Export Tools
features.description: Data export functionality supporting CSV, Excel, and PDF formats for accounts, journal entries, customers, suppliers, invoices, and purchase bills.

features.name: Quick Operations
features.description: Bulk actions dashboard for price updates, inventory updates, bulk email, bulk delete, and data export.

features.name: Financial Analysis
features.description: Financial analysis dashboards, ratio reports, budget vs actual comparisons, and variance analysis.

features.name: Authentication & Login
features.description: User authentication with login/logout functionality. Login redirects to main dashboard.
